title: Mara and the Ember Revisited
author: Oscar Hartwell
blurb: Beatrix Winterbourne, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
